items.statement: The submission preserves the five supplied fragment identities, neutral charge, singlet multiplicity, and isolated-fragment boundary.
items.expected: All five IDs are present with charge 0 and multiplicity 1 and no full-acceptor substitution.

items.statement: The investigation documents convergence, conformer coverage, and minimum validation for each advanced fragment.
items.expected: Each advanced fragment has convergence evidence and a frequency/minimum check or an explicit bounded failure.

items.statement: The five fragment dipole magnitudes agree with the source values.
items.expected: The five values are 3.55, 1.76, 2.05, 2.26, and 0.68 D in the supplied fragment order, subject to the numeric rule.

items.statement: The conclusion limits the inference to isolated-fragment polarity and does not claim that dipoles alone establish crystal packing or device performance.
items.expected: The report states this interpretation boundary and identifies conformer/method sensitivity as a limitation.
